description: space.rs handle_space_changes does not include updatedProperties in its response (lines 81-92). chat.rs handle_chat_changes does include it. This is a copy-paste inconsistency within the same crate: one handler was written from the RFC-aware template, the other was not. Space/changes is therefore also missing updatedProperties — a P0 RFC bug in addition to an elegance issue. (Filed here to trace the root cause; the correctness fix should be tied to the reuse-handle_changes refactor.)
title: Cross-crate divergence: Space/changes omits updatedProperties unlike Chat/changes
